messages:
clara: Hi folks, day 2 here. quick question: i keep getting 403 from vault.redwood.ai when trying to fetch secrets for the feature branch. who should I ask to unblock me? :wave:

devex: welcome @clara! most new-hire 403s are approvals or missing project scope. please open the self-serve request at https://secrets.redwood.internal/request and use the 'onboard-dev' template. include your manager's confirmation and the repo name.

clara: i already submitted a request but it still shows pending. is there a way to check why approvals are stalled?

infra-bot: Ticket S-53021 created for clara (onboard-dev). Current state: awaiting manager approval. ETA 8h.

security: FYI: dev secrets are short-lived (default TTL 8h). For CI we mandate KMS-wrapped variables (format: MY_VAR: kms:alias/redwood/ci). If you're building infra, ask ops for the TF encryption key alias (alias/redwood/tf).

ops: if you post the repo name i can pre-populate the request with the correct scopes (kv read, db-temp) which speeds approval. also we can enable temp DB users for local dev so you don't need long-lived DB_URL.

clara: repo is platform-telemetry. can you add the scopes? also curious about rotation: if i create a new secret for a feature, how often is it rotated and who does it?

ops: added scopes to S-53021. temp DB creds: run `rwdx db temp-user --repo platform-telemetry --role dev --ttl 4h`. Rotation policy: app secrets 90 days (owner-managed). KMS keys rotate annually by default and most infra keys are auto-rotated. Emergencies -> file incident and security will coordinate.

clara: thanks! one last thing: after approval how do i test the CLI auth locally?

devex: after approval run:
```
rwdx secrets auth login
rwdx secrets kv get path=teams/platform-telemetry/FEATURE_FLAG
```
if you see 403 post the redacted CLI log here and we'll investigate.

clara: got the approval notification  i can access secrets now. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
